products.title: Lattafa Khamrah Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Khamrah Eau De Parfum is a warm, spicy, and irresistibly sweet unisex fragrance that is an oriental charm with a modern twist. Known for its rich cinnamon and vanilla profile, Khamrah is a bold scent inspired by Arabian traditions and global luxury tastes. Often compared to high-end niche perfumes, Lattafa Khamrah offers an affordable alternative without compromising on quality or performance. This perfume is ideal for people who enjoy strong, lasting fragrances with a warm, dessert-like aroma.

products.title: Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum
products.body_html: Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum is a bold and irresistible fragrance for men who love to make a lasting impression. Launched in 2022, this woody spicy scent blends warm bourbon vanilla with fresh ginger and rich woodsy notes. It’s a strong yet smooth perfume, perfect for men who are confident, daring, and never afraid to stand out. The sleek black bottle with a gun-chamber design reflects power and elegance, just like the scent inside.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Soul of Bali Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Soul of Bali Extrait de Parfum is a tropical and spicy unisex scent that feels fresh, warm, and smooth. It opens with juicy mango, pineapple, rhubarb, and bergamot with a little ginger and pink pepper spice. The heart brings saffron, cardamom, and soft woody tones, while the base of ambergris, sandalwood, musk, and cypriol gives it a long-lasting warm finish. It is classy, bold, and easy to wear for many occasions.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud Eau de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex perfume from the house of Swiss Arabian. The perfume has a very deep Middle Eastern oud style with a slight and soft sweet note. The opening of the fragrance is that of warm saffron, then the main note of strong oud and rose takes over and finally a very rich and creamy base of praline, vanilla and oud.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Tonka Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Tonka Eau de Parfum is a rich, warm and sweet unisex fragrance made for people who enjoy deep gourmand scents. The opening is slightly sweet with a creamy feeling coming from the soft, nutty almond note. Then, the floral notes of the Tunisian orange blossom and Turkish rose come together with the warm cinnamon in a smooth and cozy heart of the fragrance. The dry down is where the magic stays, with tonka bean, vanilla and amberwood creating a long lasting, addictive scent trail.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Oud Azraq Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Oud Azraq Eau de Parfum is a rich and deep unisex fragrance made for people who enjoy bold oud scents with sweetness. It opens with a smooth honey note merged with dark agarwood, giving a warm and slightly sweet start. The middle contains spicy cinnamon entwined with rich, creamy vanilla and amber, which is pleasant and comforting. The base comprises patchouli and leather, creating a strong, staying Middle Eastern aura. It feels luxurious, warm and powerful, but still wearable.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Vanilla Toffee Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Vanilla Toffee Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and comforting unisex fragrance made for people who love dessert style perfumes. It starts off with a powerful outburst of toffee and coffee that is melted and roasted and it gives a warm and friendly feeling. Meanwhile, the notes of vanilla and walnut, milk and dates become quite smooth and edible. The long lasting and the deep base consists of brown sugar, rich Madagascar vanilla, vanilla caviar, tonka bean, woody notes, benzoin and soft musk.

products.title: Montale Arabians Tonka Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Arabians Tonka Eau de Parfum is a warm, rich and sweet oriental scent made for both men and women. It combines bold spices with deep woods and smooth sweetness. The very beginning gives us saffron and bergamot, which form a brilliant start with a bit of spice. The heart is, of course, very powerful with oud and Bulgarian rose. Finally, the dry down is very warm and cozy with tonka bean, sugar cane, amber, white musk and oakmoss.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Man Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Man Eau de Parfum is a fresh and bold men’s fragrance from the house of Swiss Arabian. It opens with a clean mix of citrus and lavender that feels fresh and energetic from the first spray. As it settles, you can feel the spiciness and the marine notes, which contribute to the fragrance a little depth and a pleasant oceanic feel. The warm, sweet and woody base is formed by the blending of amber, patchouli, and creamy praline notes.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Royal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud Royal Eau de Parfum is a unisex scent that brings together the luxuriousness of oud and warm, spicy fragrances. Launched in 2023, it starts with a note of glamorous saffron and fresh lavender, then a heart of strong oud and nutmeg, all resting on an attractive base of patchouli and musk.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shumoukh Al Ghutra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shumoukh Al Ghutra Eau de Parfum is a bold and classy leather based fragrance made for men who like strong yet clean scents. It initiates with the fresh and a bit green note of the apple and soft violet along with galbanum. When it becomes stable, the rich leather and dry cedar emerge, giving a masculine and confident air to the fragrance. The base is smooth and warm with vanilla and musk, thus making the scent everlasting and soothing yet still light.

products.title: Diptyque  Pommade Smoothing Body Polish
products.body_html:
This velvety body polish with exfoliating grains delivers all the benevolence of the pomegranate, queen of fruits.
Perfumed with Arabian jasmine, pink peppercorn and peach, this rich, creamy-textured care product combines the fine qualities of pomegranate oil, jasmine floral water and peach butter.
